title: polypodium lanceolatum var. elongatum
intro: Polypodium lanceolatum var. elongatum, commonly known as the Elongate Polypody, is a type of fern that belongs to the Polypodiaceae family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its ability to promote wound healing, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues. The health benefits of Elongate Polypody include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are derived from its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which can help to soothe and protect the body from various health problems.
